title: Google Research&\#x27;s DeepCrossAttention claims up to 3x transformer speedup
summary: Google Research has described DeepCrossAttention, a transformer residual-connection technique that it says can deliver model quality comparable to standard approaches while running up to 3x faster. The claim comes from a research blog post, not independent benchmarks or a shipped product; the available summary does not specify the baseline, workload, or whether the speedup applies to training or inference.

references.title: Supercharging transformer residual connections - Google Research
